card.name: Punctuation inside medical lists
card.fires_on: Punctuation (a comma, an opening parenthesis or a period) that comes right after a drug or condition name inside a list. It sits in the middle of a list of drugs or risk conditions, just before the next item.

modes.label: Parenthesis after drug name
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after co-trimoxazole, just before its components trimethoprim and sulfamethoxazole.

modes.label: Comma in condition list
modes.description: A comma after Head Injury in the opioid warning list of conditions, before 'or Impaired Consciousness'.
